_comment: Mid-engine V8 sports car with an eight-speed dual-clutch gearbox. Reference: 2020 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray Z51 ; model: Sketchfab 2019 Chevrolet Corvette C8 Stingray by Haris3D (CC BY 4.0). The generated Meridian Z body remains in art/cars/meridian_z.glb.
name: Corvette Stingray Z51 (C8)

sources.calibration: Car and Driver: 2.8 s to 60 mph and 149 ft from 70 mph (first test), 148 ft and 1.03 g (long-term 2021 Z51); 3647 lb measured; 40/60 weight split (Chevrolet).
sources.engine: 495 hp at 6450 rpm, 470 lb-ft at 5150 rpm with the Z51 exhaust (Chevrolet); curve shape estimated.
sources.gearing: Eight-speed DCT ratios and 5.17 final drive: unverified.
sources.tyres: Staggered 245/35ZR19 front, 305/30ZR20 rear: the rear axle grips 25 % harder (axle_grip, estimate); the model uses one rolling radius, the rear's.
sources.estimates: Centre of gravity, inertia (scaled, 15 % less yaw for the mid engine), spring and bar rates (2.0/2.2 Hz), dampers, launch, brakes, tyre grip (calibrated).

calibration_open: 0-60 mph 3.6 s against 2.8 s: Car and Driver omits a 1 ft rollout (about 0.3 s on this launch) while the bench times from rest, and the launch is grip-limited in first gear without a slip-dependent tyre curve
